comprehensibility.reason: 'the energy source' assumes the reader knows from the parent that it is BMS SoC or ENG fuel level.
comprehensibility.suggestion: Name the source inline, e.g. 'the remaining energy reported by the product's energy source (BMS state of charge or ENG fuel level)'.

feasibility.reason: Implementable with known automotive technology; contradicts nothing stated.

parent_fit.reason: Covers the energy-percentage output of ARCH_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY (a distinct part; the range output is left to another requirement).

unambiguity.reason: One reading: the energy-source value in percent, rounded to 1 %, every second.

variant_consistency.reason: Ungated in the ungated vcu folder, same as its ungated parent ARCH_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY; product-neutral wording.

verifiability.reason: Unit (percent), resolution (1 %) and period (1 s) are all stated and measurable on the cluster bus.
